text:
incident-bot: 🔔 SEV1 alert: Significant quality regression detected for tenant Acme Corp (tenant_id=acme-123) on Dedicated pool dp-west-2-7 affecting model redwood-7b-q8. Deviation: sudden BLEU/ROUGE drop and hallucination rate spike. Root event: quantization profile rollout 'q8-aggressive-v2' at 2026-03-15T02:01Z.

sara_oncall: saw the page, joining. Can everyone paste quick evidence?

mike_ml: pasting eval diffs:
```
Before (baseline q4f16): avg_loss=1.12, halluc_rate=0.7%
After (q8-aggressive-v2): avg_loss=1.68, halluc_rate=8.9%
Sample failures: prompt id 7c9a -> invented company addresses, bad persona switches
```

sara_oncall: thanks. Confirming impact limited to: Acme (dedicated VPC pool dp-west-2-7). No other tenants show signal in global metrics.

diana_platform: confirmed isolation: scheduling/placement logs show only nodes tagged dp-west-2-7 had the new quant profile. Routing rules: tenant pinned to pool until manual change.

cs_elaine: ping — AcmeCS just reported customer complaints: multiple production users saw bad generations since ~02:03Z. They're asking for ETA.

ops-bot: Paging eng-ml and eng-runtime oncall.

sara_oncall: immediate mitigation options: 1) revert quantization profile rollout (fast but requires inference runtime restart for those nodes), 2) route Acme to previous model artifact (works if artifact exists and compatible), 3) toggle per-tenant safety filter to reject risky outputs (stopgap). I propose revert rollout + notify customer. Thoughts?

mike_ml: agree revert profile. Root cause looks like this quantization setting aggressively collapses KV-cache precision for certain attention heads — not safe for our enterprise prompts. I have a revert PR ready to re-pin profile to `q4f16-stable`: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4321 (contains rollback config and post-checks).

sara_oncall: can you run the revert? I can coordinate node restarts and health checks. Steps I'd run:
```
# 1. mark pool as draining for new deploys
redwoodctl pools update dp-west-2-7 --drain=true
# 2. apply profile rollback
redwoodctl profiles apply --pool dp-west-2-7 --profile q4f16-stable --source pr-4321
# 3. restart runtime pods on impacted nodes (rolling, 1 at a time)
kubectl -n inference rollout restart daemonset/runtime-dp-west-2-7 --selector=pool=dp-west-2-7
# 4. smoke tests (sanity prompts + customer sample prompts)
```

diana_platform: note: rolling restarts will cause transient latency spikes ~30-90s per pod. We'll keep autoscaler tolerance up and drain connections.

mike_ml: starting PR deploy now. I'll apply to staging then target dp-west-2-7. Expect ~8 nodes affected. ETA ~12 minutes to start, 25-30m to finish with smoke tests.

cs_elaine: I'll message Acme (private channel) that we're reverting a recent optimization and expect limited disruption for up to 30 minutes. Keeping them posted.

sara_oncall: handoff note: I'm going to run the rollout with mike but in 20m I need to handoff to night oncall. @jay_night-oncall — please standby to monitor post-revert metrics and coordinate if anything regresses.

jay_night-oncall: standing by. Make sure to add me to the customer thread and share smoke test logs.

ops-bot: action started: created incident runbook https://internal.redwood/ops/incidents/2018765432 and triggered metric monitors for hallucination_rate/tenant/acme-123.

sara_oncall: applying PR now (kickoff 2018765650). I'll update with progress.

[~10m later]

mike_ml: PR applied to dp-west-2-7 (2018766200). Rolling restarts in progress. Currently 3/8 nodes restarted. No failed pods.

sara_oncall: smoke tests after node-3 restart: baseline prompts pass, customer sample prompt returns expected structured output. Hallucination samples reduced in quick checks.

[~18m after start]

mike_ml: roll complete. All 8 nodes back with q4f16-stable. Running full regression sweep now (~5 mins).

ops-bot: monitor update: hallucination_rate for acme-123 trending down from 8.9% -> 0.9% over last 15m. Latency stable within SLO.

cs_elaine: told Acme that we reverted and saw improvements; they're running internal validation and will confirm. They're grateful for speed.

sara_oncall: closing immediate mitigation: reverted quant profile, verified smoke tests and customer reports positive. Creating follow-ups: postmortem, stricter canary gates for quant profiles (block rollout to dedicated pools until sanity evals), update runbooks to include tenant-specific rollback playbook.

mike_ml: adding action items to PR #4321: add preflight eval harness using customer-like prompts, require 72h staged canary on small subset before wide promotion, and add automatic rollback if hallucination_rate > 2% within first hour.

jay_night-oncall: I have the incident. I will monitor next 4 hours and escalate if metrics go above thresholds. Leaving a note in the incident runbook about handoff.

sara_oncall: thanks all. Postmortem owner: mike_ml. I'll mark incident SEV1 -> mitigated.

incident-bot: Incident 2018765432 status: mitigated -> monitoring. All updates will be appended to runbook.

[items for post-incident followup]
- Owner: mike_ml
- CS outreach: cs_elaine to schedule call w/ Acme and provide timeline + RCA
- Fixes: tighten canary gating + add per-tenant simulation tests before quant profile rollout
- Timeline entry: PR #4321, rollback applied at 2018766200.

End of thread.
